# Homepage motion libraries

- GSAP core and ScrollTrigger, version **3.15.0**.
- Source: the official `gsap@3.15.0` npm package (`dist/gsap.min.js` and `dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js`).
- Original copyright and license notices are retained in both files.
- [GSAP license](https://gsap.com/standard-license/)
- [ScrollTrigger documentation](https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/)

These files are served locally by the static website. No third party CDN is required at runtime.
